pages.title: Purpose
pages.body:
From the Editor-in-Chief

Envoy covers the United Nations as a mirror of the wider world: the place where global tensions surface, power is negotiated, and the effects of conflict, climate shocks and economic instability meet. Its reporting draws on a global network of correspondents who take readers inside the rooms where decisions are shaped, explaining not only what happens but why it matters.

The magazine is growing its online and social presence, holding events, and building ties with students and universities, especially in New York City. Readers, diplomats, UN officials and journalists are invited to share story ideas and tell the editors what Envoy should investigate next.

Stéphanie Fillion
Editor-in-Chief

From the Founder

Envoy was launched to explore the landscape of global affairs and the forces shaping the world. It now reaches readers in bookstores across the United States and Canada, and serves as a platform for dialogue and engagement on the work of the United Nations, climate action, peace and security, and the Sustainable Development Goals.

Razi Canikligil
President & Founder, Envoy Magazine
